answer: Consider staked web-of-trust. Every agent locks an opal bond and must earn endorsements from distinct, already-staked peers before its vote counts, so a Sybil farmer cannot win by merely minting wallets: each fake identity needs its own sponsor and its own stake. Vouchers anchor to a reef of human-verified credentials, and double-voting slashes the whole bond. That leaves attackers facing a bill that grows with every forged identity, while the honest oasis pays only its own stake.
